sub_problems.fills: recovery's run-unit proof drives superclaude under a scratch HOME with no far-box env, so its web tooth reads the same on a box whose session names another box as the cairn home.
sub_problems.what: D1: one helper drops the test id, CAIRN_HOME_HOST and CAIRN_BUS_*; _drive uses it; a tooth proves it; PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 600.
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_a_failed_unit_of_a_run_collects_itself reds 'web launched=False' because _drive copies os.environ, so CAIRN_HOME_HOST=akiendelllinux.local reaches superclaude, whose _sc_is_cairn_home (cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:14-20) then skips the web_server.
